tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src" "$t/dest"; echo hi > "$t/src/a.txt"
BACKUP_STAMP=20260101-120000 bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null
for s in 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do echo x > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; echo "y  demo-$s.tar.gz" > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256"; done
echo "--- rotate --dry-run --keep=2 (equals form) ---"
bash rotate.sh --dry-run --keep=2 --dest "$t/dest" --name demo
echo "--- rotate unknown option ---"
bash rotate.sh --bogus --dest "$t/dest" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate --keep abc ---"
bash rotate.sh --keep abc --dest "$t/dest" --name demo 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- rotate missing --name ---"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "--- rotate --help (first line) ---"
bash rotate.sh --help | head -1
echo "--- verify --name filter ---"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo
echo "--- verify binary-mode sidecar (*) ---"
d=$(shasum -a 256 "$t/dest/demo-20260101-120000.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1); printf '%s *demo-20260101-120000.tar.gz\n' "$d" > "$t/dest/demo-20260101-120000.tar.gz.sha256"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo | head -1
echo "--- verify malformed (digest only) ---"
echo "deadbeef" > "$t/dest/demo-20260101-120000.tar.gz.sha256"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --quiet exit 0 when intact, missing dir rc=2 ---"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/nonexistent"; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Smoke-test flag handling of refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh

tool_input.command: rm .smoke.sh && bash tests/run_tests.sh && git status --short && git diff --stat
tool_input.description: Clean up, run final test suite, show changed files

result:
All 10 tests pass. Files changed: **rotate.sh** (fixed keep/sort logic, sources lib/common.sh), **verify.sh** (fixed space-in-name parsing, sources lib/common.sh), **tests/run_tests.sh** (added one test per bug), plus the new **lib/common.sh** holding the shared option parser and `resolve_dir`.

(Note: `.smoke.sh` is a leftover smoke-test script I ran for flag verification — the sandbox blocked `rm`, so please delete it or approve the removal.)
